description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Starts from user problems, not feature lists. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Role-specific interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description: About Verra Mobility Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart transportation technology, helping the world move safely and efficiently. We serve the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies, managing tolling, violations, and title & registration for over 8.5 million vehicles across North America and Europe. Our platforms process nearly 165 million transactions annually, connecting vehicles, data, and people in ways that drive real impact. The Opportunity We're looking for a Product Manager to join our EU Products portfolio, focusing on Tolling and Enforcement products. This is a high-complexity, regulated product area that directly impacts how governments entities, fleets, rental companies, and their customers navigate vehicle tolling and regulation enforcement across multiple jurisdictions. You'll join a product squad with a defined problem space, embedded alongside a technical lead and engineering team. But this isn't a backlog-grooming role, as you'll own discovery: getting in front of customers, validating the problems, stress-testing potential solutions, and driving a roadmap that delivers measurable outcomes. You'll report directly to the VP of Product, Commercial Services, and operate as a key contributor as we build toward a modern Product Operating Model. What You'll Do Own the problem, drive discovery Lead continuous customer discovery, including interviews, ride-alongs, and data analysis, to validate problems and pressure-test solutions before committing to build. Frame customer and business problems with clarity and evidence, ensuring the team works on what truly matters. Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap grounded in measurable outcomes, rather than a feature wish list. Balance user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility, using sound judgment and solid product sense. Partner early with Legal, Compliance, and Operations functions to shape viable solutions. Own the problem end-to-end, make tough prioritization calls, document your reasoning and outcomes. Guide delivery and build trust with your squad Partner closely with your technical lead and engineering team, creating context, removing ambiguity, and enabling the squad to move with speed and confidence. Collaborate closely with your design lead to ensure solutions are not just technically sound but also user centered. Write crisp, outcome-oriented briefs and acceptance criteria; avoid over-specifying how and focus on why and what success looks like. Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, documentation, and delivery workflows. Share your approach to discovery and product thinking with peers, contributing to a growing product practice. Connect product to commercial impact Develop a working understanding of how T&R products drive revenue, retention, and operational efficiency for our commercial customers. Contribute to go-to-market strategy by informing pricing, positioning, and launch readiness in close collaboration with commercial teams. Define and track success metrics that link customer outcomes to business performance. Serve as the internal expert on your product area trusted by sales, operations, and leadership. What We're Looking For Required 3–7 years of product management experience in a B2B or B2B2C environment, with a track record of owning outcomes. Experience leading customer discovery and translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions. Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional squad environment alongside engineering and design peers. Experience in regulated or complex-domain industries, such as automotive, fleet, payments, fintech, insurtech, or similar, with a demonstrated record of learning new domains. Comfort working in and contributing to organizations evolving their product operating model. Active use of AI tools to enhance productivity in day-to-day product work, such as discovery workflows, streamlining documentation, automating research, creating prototypes. Excellent written and verbal communication: you write clearly, tailor your message to different audiences, and tell a coherent product story. Strong critical thinking and a bias toward evidence over opinion. Great to Have Experience with vehicle titling, registration, tolling, fleet management, or rental car operations. Background working with large commercial or enterprise customers. Familiarity with product tooling such as Aha!, Azure DevOps, JIRA, or comparable platforms. Experience working with compliance, legal, or regulatory stakeholders in a multi-jurisdiction environment. What Success Looks Like In this role, you're not measured by how much you ship, you're measured by the outcomes you drive with your team. In your first year, success looks like: Deep fluency in the T&R problem space, backed by direct customer and stakeholder engagement. A validated, outcome-oriented roadmap your squad believes in and can execute against. Demonstrated velocity in shipping, learning, and adjusting with confidence. Trusted relationships that enable influence without authority to drive alignment across engineering, design, commercial, and other operational functions. Clear evidence of customer impact: reduced friction, improved adoption, or measurable efficiency gains. Logistics Location: Verra Mobility office in Amsterdam Travel: Some travel expected to our development office in Madrid and for customer visits. Reports to: VP of Product, Commercial Services. Our Values Verra Mobility's culture is built on four principles that guide how we work: Do What's Right — Integrity is our DNA. Courage over Comfort — Lean into the difficult, prioritizing progress over ease. Own It — We hold ourselves accountable and go the extra mile. Win Together — We're ambitious, and we know we go further as a team. Verra Mobility Values An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values: Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation. Do What's Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous. Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease. Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others. With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. Verra Mobility Applicant Privacy Notice Verra Mobility is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

description: About Turing: Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview: In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
